interpretation.learned: The fixed initiation primitive eliminated the launch-sequence defect and post-launch PPO improved altitude, high contacts, and forward transfers without degrading the human aerial prior.
interpretation.not_learned: Broad moving-intercept PPO plateaued below the frozen high-contact gate, especially on the Blue physical perspective.
interpretation.next_experiment: Use explicit Rocket-League-style aerial shot packs with deterministic launch, touch, ball-ground, possession, and goal deadlines. The episode should reset on each failed stage and train increasingly varied airborne shots instead of broad random interception states.
